notes: Previous accepted Super HQQ4+k4v4 run after GQA tensor release and RoPE table reuse, before Mamba2 projection INT4 cache.

First Mamba2 projection INT4 startup run built 80/80 cached tensors and replaced the 8360.0 MB BF16 projection bucket with 2220.6 MB INT4, but exposed a real Mamba2 SSD runtime-temp reserve bug and OOMed during long calibration.

After adding config-derived Mamba2 SSD runtime-temp reserve, startup calibration passed at 15191 tokens, loaded 7084/20480 soft HCS experts, and ended near the 600 MB safety margin after pressure eviction.

Post-review startup diagnostic rebuilt the Mamba2 projection INT4 cache with a source_signature-bound manifest, reached KRASIS SERVER READY, and reproduced the same startup free and HCS pressure state. The process was stopped with ./dev kill because the startup exit hook did not terminate after ready.
Final timing-off benchmark with cached Mamba2 projection INT4 artifacts. Accepted for VRAM, HCS residency, and decode speed; only a small best-prefill gain versus the prior accepted run.
